description.en: The description of the IP address blacklist.

description.zh:
生效截止时间戳，单位为秒。
> 取值为**0**时，表示永久生效。
description.en:
The timestamp after which the IP address blacklist becomes invalid. Unit: seconds.

> If you set this parameter to **0**, the IP address blacklist is permanently valid.
The ID of the WAF instance.

description.zh:
添加的IP黑名单。支持自定义IP或IP段黑名单，同时支持IPv4和IPv6。多个IP之间用半角逗号（,）分隔。
更多信息，请参见[重保场景防护](~~425591~~)。
description.en: The IP address blacklist to add. You can specify custom IP addresses or CIDR blocks. Both IPv4 and IPv6 addresses are supported. Separate multiple IP addresses with commas (,). For more information, see [Critical event protection](~~425591~~).

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region of the WAF instance. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: regions outside the Chinese mainland.
